acceptance_predicates.description: After successful broker admission, `asb tui` remains interactive beyond the former 15-second deadline until normal user exit or an explicit cancellation/signal path.
Admission, handshake, failed-child, cancellation, server failure, and cleanup remain bounded and terminate only the ASB-owned child group.
A controlling PTY proves foreground ownership during the session and exact caller terminal restoration after normal and failure exits.
Human and JSON output distinguish launch/admission/control/child/terminal outcomes without raw child output or secrets.
A real installed-entrypoint PTY regression covers input, a session longer than 15 seconds, normal quit, cleanup, and caller restoration.

definition_of_done: The installed `asb tui` route no longer kills a healthy interactive session at 15 seconds.
Interactive and failure PTY behavior is deterministically covered without weakening broker or terminal safety.
Independent review, signed-DCO merge, exact-head CI, and post-merge installed-entrypoint qualification pass.

inputs.description: Existing foreground terminal handoff and cleanup contract.

outputs.description: ASB broker launcher with separate bounded admission and unbounded healthy interactive lifetime.

gates.description: Installed-route PTY lifetime, input, quit, terminal restoration, and hostile cleanup matrix passes.
Independent exact-head review, signed-DCO merge, exact-head CI, and exact-main post-merge qualification pass.
